results.id: update meet the customer by customer account|gen_meetthecustomer|UPDATE|gen_status
results.detail: Re-derived from the raw DTSX. Constants are private int FINISH = 3, WRONG = 4 (DTSX:10288-10289). The writer checks Row.genstatus == WRONG (DTSX:10392-10393). Otherwise gen_status = FINISH when !gencalculatescore_IsNull (DTSX:10406-10407). Match rows carry source gen_status in (1,2) (source WHERE DTSX:9944-9950). No-match rows get 'Set Status To Wrong' = DATEADD("DD",-180,GETDATE()) <= createdon ? gen_status : 8 (DTSX:10001-10002). Only gen_status == 8 passes 'Wrong Records' (DTSX:9849-9850); the default output has no path. So 4 can never occur, and 3 is the only value written, also for unmatched rows older than 180 days. Rows with NULL gen_calculatescore on the no-match path are still added to the batch as an Entity with only an Id, i.e. an empty Update. Note: the DB-source list does not show gen_precustomeridnumber (the lookup key) as an influence on gen_status, although match/no-match decides whether recent rows are written at all. The write-condition text does cover it.
results.evidence: DTSX:9944-9950, 10001-10002, 9849-9850, 10288-10289, 10389-10414; paths list (no path from Default Output / writer outputs)

results.detail: Code matches: STATUS_NO_ACCOUNT 8 -> 8. Otherwise, if all four key columns are non-NULL: on equality and non-NULL gen_calculatescore -> FINISH 3; if bank equal and id different -> WORNG 4. If any key column is NULL -> WORNG 4 (DTSX:8702-8704, 8806-8835). Match rows come via Union All Input 3 (Lookup Match). No-match rows older than 180 days come via 'Set Status To No Account' + Conditional Split gen_status == 8 (DTSX:8375-8376, 8155-8156). The lookup keys are gen_precustomeridnumber -> gen_customeridnumber and gen_pregemelaccountnumber (LTRIM/RTRIM in SQL, then PadLeft(12,'0') in place when Length <= 12, Add Zeros main.cs DTSX:7555-7558) -> gen_bankaccountnumber. productsubcustomeraccount (CASE 2<->4) is returned but is neither a join key nor used in code. The analyst labels the NULL-key path to 4 as a hypothesis, which is correct. By documented SSIS behaviour, a full-cache Lookup matches NULL to NULL, so this path is plausible when gen_pregemelaccountnumber is NULL.
